pr_body:
This stops the `BlockHash`es from emitting empty pages when the batch size and number of results from a page lines up. It doesn't hurt the aggs, but it was making testing more complex than we'd like.

Closes #112443
Closes #112442
pr_title: ESQL: Don't emit empty pages from hashes
pr_comment:
> I noticed the bot muted the failing tests in the meantime. I pushed a change that only unmutes them again, so we don't accidentally close the issues without unmuting.

Oh thanks!

review_comment: I could have made this come naturally when you `close()` the thing, but I felt like that'd be confusing.
